ephemera.ui.unsaved: Changes apply live and save when you press Done.
ephemera.ui.hint: Hover an option to see what it does. Tab switches pages, arrow keys adjust the hovered option.
ephemera.ui.shaderReload: Fog, dithering, and horizon changes apply when shaders reload (Visuals page or F3+T).
ephemera.tooltip.fullscreenMode.windowed: A normal resizable window. F11 switches to the fullscreen mode chosen here last.
ephemera.tooltip.fullscreenMode.borderle: A borderless window covering the whole monitor at the desktop resolution. Alt-Tab is instant and the game never minimizes or changes the display mode. Adaptive sync (G-Sync, FreeSync) may not engage.
ephemera.tooltip.fullscreenMode.exclusiv: Takes over the monitor at the Fullscreen Resolution below. Adaptive sync (G-Sync, FreeSync) works, but Alt-Tab is slower and some input methods may not work.
ephemera.tooltip.reloadShaders: Reloads resource packs so the patched core shaders are rebuilt with your current fog, dithering, and horizon settings.
ephemera.tooltip.visualSmoothFog: Replaces the harsh linear fog edge with a smooth S-curve across terrain, sky, clouds, and underwater. Applies on shader reload.
ephemera.tooltip.visualGradientDithering: Adds invisible blue-ish noise to fog and sky gradients to remove 8-bit color banding. Applies on shader reload.
ephemera.tooltip.visualDitherStrength: How strong the dithering noise is. 1.00 is one color step; raise it if banding is still visible.
ephemera.tooltip.visualAtmosphericHorizo: Subtle warm haze near the render-distance horizon. Never affects underwater or lava fog. Applies on shader reload.
ephemera.tooltip.visualUnderwaterClarity: Extends underwater visibility so the sea floor stays readable.
ephemera.tooltip.visualDynamicLights: Held torches, lanterns, lava buckets, burning mobs, and other emitters light nearby entities, items, and hands. Terrain is not re-lit, so there are no chunk rebuilds.
ephemera.tooltip.visualDynamicLightsUpda: How often entity emitters are re-scanned. 0 scans about every millisecond; higher values trade smoothness for speed.
ephemera.tooltip.visualHeldWorldLight: Separate terrain-shader held light: softly illuminates nearby cave walls and blocks around your held torch, lantern, or glow item with zero chunk rebuilds. Stands down automatically for Iris/Oculus shader packs, Sodium, VulkanMod, and dynamic-light mods. Turning off applies immediately; turning on applies live on Vulkan Mesh Shaders or after Reload Shaders (F3+T) on standard terrain.
ephemera.tooltip.visualHeldWorldLightRad: Maximum reach in blocks of Held World Light (scales down for dimmer items like redstone torches). Shorter radii reduce wall light leaking.
ephemera.tooltip.visualHeldWorldLightStr: Brightness multiplier of Held World Light on nearby terrain.
ephemera.tooltip.visualEnhancedAmbientOc: Contrast polish on smooth-lighting shadows. Rebuild chunks (F3+A) to see changes.
ephemera.tooltip.visualAoStrength: 1.00 is vanilla. Higher values deepen corner shadows, lower values soften them.
ephemera.tooltip.visualSmoothChunkFade: New chunks glide in with an ease-out curve instead of a linear fade. Needs Chunk Fade enabled in vanilla video settings.
ephemera.tooltip.visualChunkFadeDuration: Fade length used while smooth chunk fade is on. 0 keeps the vanilla duration.
ephemera.tooltip.visualCrispMipmaps: Sharper textures at a distance and at steep angles using anisotropic filtering.
ephemera.tooltip.visualAnisotropicLevel: Anisotropic filtering strength for the block atlas. Clamped to what your GPU supports.
ephemera.tooltip.visualSmoothBiomeBlendi: Smooths biome color transitions. Provided by the terrain engine.
ephemera.tooltip.visualBetterLeavesShadi: Softer shading on leaf blocks. Provided by the terrain engine.
ephemera.tooltip.visualBetterGrass: Connects grass side textures to neighboring grass. Provided by the terrain engine.
ephemera.tooltip.visualCleanGlassBorders: Removes inner borders between adjacent glass panes. Provided by the terrain engine.
ephemera.tooltip.diagnosticsHudOverlay: Shows a compact FPS, 1% low, frame time, and culling readout in the top-left corner while playing.
ephemera.tooltip.terrainEngineEnabled: Master switch for Ephemera's terrain renderer. Restart required.
ephemera.tooltip.modStandDownEnabled: Turn Ephemera features off automatically when another mod already provides them. Restart required.
ephemera.tooltip.chunkBuilderThreads: 0 picks a count tuned to your CPU.
ephemera.tooltip.leavesCullingMode: How aggressively interior leaf faces are skipped.
ephemera.tooltip.guiFontAtlasResizing: Uses larger glyph atlas pages to reduce texture switches when rendering text. Applies to newly allocated pages after a resource reload (F3+T) or restart.
ephemera.tooltip.guiFontAtlasSize: Glyph atlas texture size used when Font Atlas Resizing is enabled. Applies on resource reload (F3+T) or restart.
ephemera.tooltip.unfocusedFpsLimit: Frame rate cap while the game window is in the background.
ephemera.tooltip.memoryDeduplicateModels: Canonicalizes identical baked quad positions, materials, and quads during model baking and clears lookup tables after reload so old packs never leak.
ephemera.tooltip.memoryLeakGuard: Sweeps world-scoped occlusion, item, dynamic-light, and terrain caches on disconnect or resource reload so old worlds and players never remain pinned in RAM.
ephemera.tooltip.memoryTrimNativeBuffers: Shrinks bloated off-heap ByteBufferBuilder and Vulkan staging allocations back down after sustained low usage to stop native RSS leaks.
ephemera.tooltip.framePacerEnabled: High-precision frame cadence with fast-attack OS park-overshoot compensation and anti-sawtooth recovery. Automatically yields blocking sleeps to Aurora Client when paired.
ephemera.tooltip.framePacerLowLatency: Paces at frame head before input/tick/render for lower input latency when Ephemera owns frame pacing.
ephemera.tooltip.framePacerAdaptiveUploa: Dynamically caps per-frame terrain GPU uploads to fit inside the remaining frame budget (synced with Aurora Client's target FPS when paired) so chunk streaming never tanks 1% lows.
ephemera.tooltip.borderlessFlipOptimizat: Sizes the borderless fullscreen window exactly to the monitor so Windows can present frames directly (Independent Flip) instead of compositing them, and enables adaptive VSync in borderless OpenGL when supported. Cuts a frame of latency and removes most borderless stutter. Turn off if alt-tab flickers black on your driver.
ephemera.tooltip.windowsLowLatencyRuntim: Uses the 1 ms Windows timer and high-resolution waitable timer so the frame pacer wakes on time, and opts out of Windows 11 Efficiency Mode while enabled. Turning it off restores the default Windows timer and power-throttling policy.
ephemera.tooltip.captureOptimizationMode: Auto uses a running-app heuristic that turns on whenever OBS, Streamlabs, XSplit, Medal, Bandicam or Action! is open (even while idle). Set Off or On to control it manually. While active, the capture FPS cap applies (when Adaptive Frame Pacer is on), the pacer caps busy-spinning to yield CPU to the encoder, and chunk uploads are smoothed.
ephemera.tooltip.captureFpsCapMode: Frame rate cap while Streaming / Recording Mode is active (requires Adaptive Frame Pacer; when paired with a legacy Aurora pacer, Aurora owns the cap). Rendering far above the refresh rate starves the video encoder and causes dropped or laggy frames in recordings. A lower cap you set yourself still applies.
ephemera.tooltip.framePacerSpinTailMicro: Minimum sub-millisecond spin tail reserved after OS parking before the exact frame deadline.
ephemera.tooltip.backendVulkanModernGpu: Coalesced Synchronization2 barriers, -O SPIR-V shader optimization, and non-debug AMD/NVIDIA checkpoint bypass. Restart required.
ephemera.tooltip.terrainVulkanMeshShader: Nvidium-class VK_EXT_mesh_shader terrain engine for modern AMD (RDNA 2/3/4) and NVIDIA (RTX 20+) GPUs. Falls back automatically when unsupported.
ephemera.tooltip.terrainVulkanGpuCulling: GPU compute frustum, fog, and directional meshlet culling feeding a single vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectEXT call per terrain layer.
ephemera.tooltip.engineFastCollisions: Caches CubePointRange instances, active chunk sections, and AABB disjointness checks during block collision sweeps.
ephemera.tooltip.engineFastEntityLookup: Uses direct zero-allocation section probes instead of AVL subtree scans for compact entity bounding-box queries.
ephemera.tooltip.networkFastVarInt: Uses branchless lookup tables and packed multi-byte Netty writes for VarInt/VarLong packet encoding.
